name: sound-switch
title: Sound switch
description: The one control that turns Susegad's sound switch on or off, site-wide, over a native checkbox with role=switch. Checking it is the user's own gesture, so switch.js can resume the audio context right there and play the switch's own confirmation. Without JavaScript the checkbox still works as a switch but has no effect, and a note says so. Quiet is the plain switch; warm draws a small speaker with a slash when off and two arcs when on; playful breathes those arcs gently while on.
